svg.title: A countermodel of ∃x. p(x) ⊢ ∀x. p(x)
svg.desc: A finite structure, drawn as one world. World 0, the model's world, has the elements 0 and 1, and forces p(0). The structure makes every formula left of ⊢ true and every formula right of it false, so ∃x. p(x) ⊢ ∀x. p(x) is not valid in classical logic.
